body.name: Undivided supershort component branch
body.construction: For \(c\in\mathcal C_G\) and \(\sigma\in\{-1,+1\}\), \(\mathcal B_{c,\sigma}^{\mathrm{ss}}(\mu)=\{b_c\in\mathbb R^c:\nu_i^-(\mu)\le b_i\le\nu_i^+(\mu),\ \sigma b_i\ge0\ \forall i\in c,\ d_j(\mu)d_k(\mu)\ge0,\ Q_{jk}(b,\mu)\le0\ \forall(j,k)\in\vec E\cap(c\times c)\}\).
